UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION ACENCE
REGION I BUSTON AREA
J.F. KENNEDY FEDERAL BUILDING, BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS 02203 PH 177
AREA DIRECTOR
August 9, 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger
Acting Area Office Director
Department of Housing and Urban Development
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, MA 02114
Attn: Environmental Clearance Officer
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
We have completed our review of the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the proposed Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project, Cambridge, Massachusetts.
The EIS adequately addresses the project's potential impacts with regard to air, water, and noise. In addition, it appears that those impacts will not be significant if the recommended mitigating measures are implemented. We urge HUD to require that mitigating measures be incorporated into design and construction specifications.
In accordance with our national rating system, we have rated this project IO-1 (see enclosed explanation). We appreciate the opportunity to review the EIS and request that one copy of the Final be forwarded to us when it becomes available.
Sincerely,
Elizabeth A. Hippins for Wallace E. Stickney, P.E.
Director, Environmental & Economic
Impact Office
Enclosure
